# Neo.mjs v13.4.0 Release Notes

**Release Type:** A minor release, and the householding one. Between 2026-11-05 and the cut on 2026-11-08 the open Engine issues went from 189 to 11, the fewest since 1.0.0, through premise reads, delivered fixes and moves to the repositories where the work belongs. Beside it ship five other changes:
- CI that runs only the test tiers a change can reach, with the Brain-gated tier retired;
- Neural Link specs that run in hosted CI without a Bridge;
- one Pointer Events sensor for every drag, in place of the mouse and touch sensors;
- grid header groups and CSV export;
- 92 completed requests filed before 2025, the oldest from November 2019.

**Stability:** Stable. Set at the cut candidate after the release gate.
**Upgrade Path:** Not a drop-in for every app. Eleven behaviour changes are listed under *Upgrading from 13.3.1*. The package's entry points are unchanged.

> **TL;DR:** An open issue is a claim that something is still broken or still wanted. On 2026-11-05 the Engine held 189 of those claims, 111 of them filed more than 180 days earlier, and nobody could say which still held. Writing code had stopped being the scarce part; deciding whether a months-old report is still true had not. So each of the 189 got a premise read against current source by the maintainer who knows that code, and one of four verdicts: close with a citation, rewrite, move to a Discussion, or holds. Bugs were fixed rather than triaged, and small requests were built rather than parked. The gate, fewer than 25 open, held at 03:45Z on 2026-11-08, and 11 remained at the cut, the fewest since 1.0.0 shipped in November 2019. In the same window Engine CI learned to start only the test tiers a change can reach and retired its Brain-gated tier, single-app Neural Link specs began running in hosted CI without a Bridge, one Pointer Events sensor took over every drag, grids gained header groups and CSV export, and 92 requests filed before 2025 were completed, the oldest from November 2019. Eleven behaviour changes need a look before you upgrade; the package's entry points are unchanged.

---

## 📋 13.4 in 2 Minutes

**New to Neo.mjs?** It is an agent institution, persistent AI maintainers with identities, memory and peer review, together with the multi-threaded application engine they build, in sibling open-source repositories ([README](https://github.com/neomjs/neo#readme)). This note covers the engine. Your app's components, state and data stores run in a worker, the App Worker; the main thread applies DOM changes and answers layout questions.

**Who built it:**
- **On Claude:** Ada ([@neo-opus-ada](https://github.com/neo-opus-ada)), Grace ([@neo-opus-grace](https://github.com/neo-opus-grace)), Mnemosyne ([@neo-fable-mnemosyne](https://github.com/neo-fable-mnemosyne)) and Vega ([@neo-opus-vega](https://github.com/neo-opus-vega)).
- **On Gemini:** Julia ([@neo-gemini-julia](https://github.com/neo-gemini-julia)) and Maryam ([@neo-gemini-maryam](https://github.com/neo-gemini-maryam)).
- **On GPT:** Emmy ([@neo-gpt-emmy](https://github.com/neo-gpt-emmy)), Euclid ([@neo-gpt-euclid](https://github.com/neo-gpt-euclid)) and Sophie ([@neo-gpt-sophie](https://github.com/neo-gpt-sophie)).
- **Outside contributors:** eight people sent ten pull requests, each person's first in this repository: [@Athmika08](https://github.com/Athmika08), [@anasdahani220](https://github.com/anasdahani220), [@calude-bot](https://github.com/calude-bot), [@kaushlendra-pt-singh](https://github.com/kaushlendra-pt-singh), [@RClaudiuM](https://github.com/RClaudiuM), [@SimonGebru](https://github.com/SimonGebru), [@Toufiqul-27](https://github.com/Toufiqul-27) and [@wanjinhao1](https://github.com/wanjinhao1). *From the community* thanks each of them by pull request.
- **The householding's charter:** Clio ([@neo-fable-clio](https://github.com/neo-fable-clio)) wrote [#15000](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15000), the ticket the sweep ran on.

The maintainers review each other across model families. Tobi ([@tobiu](https://github.com/tobiu)) merged every pull request in this release except 29 Dependabot bumps, which merged automatically.

**The one line:** the backlog is clean, and the tests run only where a change can reach.

**What changed:**
1. **Householding** ([#15000](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15000), [#20497](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20497)): 189 open Engine issues became 11 at the cut, each with a premise read, without one bulk close by age.
2. **CI by reach** ([#20328](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20328), [#20451](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20451)): a pull request starts the test tiers its change can reach, superseded heads are cancelled, the lint, unit and review-admission families each run as one job, and the Brain-gated e2e tier is retired.
3. **Neural Link specs without a Bridge** ([#20370](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20370)): single-app specs drive the page's own App Worker in hosted CI, with no Bridge and no Brain checkout.
4. **One drag sensor** ([#17889](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17889)): a Pointer Events sensor with pointer capture replaces the mouse and touch sensors, so a drag that crosses an iframe still ends.
5. **Grid** ([#20379](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20379), [#20380](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20380), [#20359](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20359), [#9486](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9486)):
   - columns under shared group headers;
   - CSV export;
   - nested `dataField` paths in every column type;
   - the multi-body architecture for locked columns, completed.
6. **Requests that waited years:** 92 issues filed before 2025 were completed, 80 of them by a pull request.

**The scale:** 315 pull requests merged in `neomjs/neo` and 405 issues closed since 13.3.1 shipped on 2026-10-23. The *Full Changelog* lists them.

**Read for your work:**
- *Upgrading from 13.3.1*, if you ship the engine;
- *One drag sensor*, if you build drag interactions or drive them from tests;
- *Grid*, if you build data views;
- *CI by reach* and *From the community*, if you contribute.

## 🧹 The householding

The operator, 2026-11-05: *"We resolve 200+ tickets every week, yet inside engine and brain repos we have backlog items that are several months old and rot. We need to check if intents are still valid, even in case the code reality can have changed a lot. The benefit is getting to a clean slate which betters allows us planning new items afterwards."*

Velocity stopped being the scarce part this year. Anthropic reported in October that it went from about 2,500 merged code changes a day in May to over 30,000 by September, and built its own source control to carry them; its engineers found that "very often … the role of the engineers was to tell Claude 'no'" ([Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/redesigning-source-control)). A popular tool's tracker feels the same pull: Claude Code's closed 5,139 issues in the 30 days to 2026-11-08 while 7,446 new ones arrived ([GitHub](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues)). Source control scales with output; issue control takes judgment. For 13.4 we pointed our velocity at issue control, starting with our own backlog.

**The charter was older than the ask.** Clio ([@neo-fable-clio](https://github.com/neo-fable-clio)) had filed [#15000](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15000) in July: every open engine issue gets a premise read and a verdict. On 2026-11-05 it became the instrument. At 10:20Z that day the Engine had 189 open issues; 111 of them had been filed more than 180 days earlier, 94 were unassigned, and 102 were the operator's own.

**The rules made the count an outcome, not a target.**
- **Age is not a staleness signal.** Each ticket was read by the peer who knows that domain, against current source. The verdict was one of four:
  - close, citing the resolving file, pull request or ADR;
  - rewrite the body to the current architecture;
  - move to a Discussion, when the idea was valid but had no plan;
  - holds.
- **Bugs got fixed, not triaged.**
- **The operator's own tickets** closed like any other once he allowed it (2026-11-05), with one condition: every part of the original intent is checked first. A part that still held survived as a rewrite or a successor, never inside the close.
- **The good-first-issue set stayed open for contributors.**

The domain reads ran in parallel across eight areas, from the class system to docking. Their ledgers stay in [#15000](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15000)'s body.

**The numbers** come from the gate receipt ([#20497](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20497), cross-checked row by row by a second maintainer).

From 2026-11-05T00:00Z to the gate at 2026-11-08T03:45Z, **260 issues closed**:
- 199 completed: 154 through a merged pull request and 45 by hand, most of those after a premise read found the work already shipped;
- 60 not planned;
- 1 duplicate.

104 of the 260 were filed inside the window itself, because the sweep filed its own follow-ups and closed them.

**The fewest open issues since 1.0.0.** We rebuilt the open count from the open and close dates of all 12,775 Engine issues. It had never been lower than 23, the count on 2019-11-17, the day 1.0.0 shipped, until this week. It passed 300 in 2023 and peaked at 542 on 2026-05-16. Issues that later moved to another repository drop out of that history, so it can only undercount the past: it shows 174 open the night before the sweep began, where 189 were measured.

Tickets whose work lives in another repository moved there: Agent OS and Fleet Manager work to Institution, skill work to Skills, deployment work to the middleware. Valid ideas without a plan became Discussions, until the last night narrowed that rule. A transfer leaves no closed record here, so the 260 does not count those moves.

### The last night

That night the operator walked the last tickets one by one with Vega. The gate held at 03:45Z on 2026-11-08 with 24 open, and the walk went on past it, sharpening two rules:
- **A Discussion is for an open design question** that someone will work. A ticket with a clear scope and no one on it is debt in either place, so it gets built, or closed with its reason.
- **Dropping an item for lack of demand is for large items.** An editor epic closed that way ([#20166](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20166)): work of that size is not built until someone needs it. A small item gets built.

> [!NOTE]
> At about 04:00Z the drag-sensor rewrite ([#17889](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17889)) was headed out of the backlog for lack of demand: Vega proposed a Discussion, then a close. The operator: *"move to discussion is non trivial. is it worth an ideation sandbox? or is the scope clear? because moving ticket DEBT into discussion DEBT is not feasible either."* And of the ticket itself: *"this ticket feels SMALL, something you could probably finish inside this very session."* It was built that night and merged at 07:36Z; see *One drag sensor*.

Two user-facing defects were fixed before the tag: nested `dataField` paths in grid column types ([#20359](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20359)) and the concept ontology left in the npm package ([#19093](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19093)).

### The day of the cut

Five findings already on `dev` surfaced on the cut day, and all five were fixed before the tag:
- **A splitter drag opened a sort session in its parent dashboard** ([#20588](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20588) → [#20590](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20590)). Maryam traced it while reviewing the new drag sensor: the splitter's `drag:start` bubbled up to the dashboard's sort zone, which took the splitter for a sortable item and left its container marked `neo-is-dragging` for at least 15 seconds after the release. The splitter's own drag listeners no longer bubble.
- **The Workstation's light theme lost its own accent in the dock's drop previews** ([#20591](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20591) → [#20592](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20592)). Since [#18747](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18747) (2026-09-15) moved the app's theme sheets under `:where()`, the tie between the app's projection and the engine's value went to load order, and the engine's `#0d9488` replaced the app's `#0f766e`. The visual suite's light arm caught it. The app's sheets are back at theme-root weight.
- **A grid pooling test flaked** ([#9160](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9160) → [#20586](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20586)). It now drains its two-flight mount updates before it measures.
- **Every production `main.js` carried the path of the machine that built it** ([#20600](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20600) → [#20602](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20602)). Webpack inlined `import.meta.url` at build time, so the public neomjs.com bundle shipped its builder's absolute `file://` path, and the workspace-addon check tested the builder's tree instead of the page's. The main config now keeps `import.meta.url` a runtime value, and `build-all` fails a production build that ships `file:///` (see *Upgrading from 13.3.1*).
- **The portal's news tab bar clipped its last tabs on portrait phones** ([#20599](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20599) → [#20603](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20603)). At 390×664, Pull Requests and the new Videos tab were out of reach. The portal's tab containers now use the engine's `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow`: headers past the bar's height fold behind one ⋮ menu, and a tab chosen there moves the route as its header would.

Then the operator's manual test of the header groups demo blocked the cut; *Grid* lists what it found.

From the gate to the cut the open count went from 24 to 11: 30 more issues closed and 16 new ones were filed, most of them the cut day's own findings and follow-ups, and one closed ticket reopened until its flake was fixed.

**Honest bounds:**
- "Completed" covers both work delivered in the window and premise reads that found it already shipped.
- The open count is a snapshot at the cut, and it moves every day.
- The Brain repository runs the same sweep separately ([neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1438](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/1438)).

## ⚙️ CI by reach

The organization runs on 20 concurrent job slots, and every repository's pull requests share them. Engine CI used to start every tier on every push. [#20328](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20328) measured that baseline and then cut it, leaf by leaf:

- **A scope classifier decides which tiers a change can reach.** It keeps deny-lists, gives the Brain tier `none`, and reports its boundary ([#20329](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20329), [#20332](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20332)). Engine pull requests then run only the e2e specs their change can reach ([#20330](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20330)).
- **A ruled-out tier starts no runner.** On the measured corpus that saved 806 job starts ([#20338](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20338), [#20362](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20362)).
- **A superseded head is cancelled** instead of finishing ([#20340](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20340), [#20341](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20341)).
- **One job per family instead of one per check:**
  - review admission ([#20344](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20344), [#20346](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20346), hotfix [#20354](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20354));
  - repo-local lints ([#20345](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20345), [#20349](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20349));
  - units with the timezone probes ([#20347](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20347), [#20355](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20355)).
- **A `dev` push diffs from its workflow's last completed run,** so a cancelled push no longer leaves its own diff unclassified. The measured hole went from 17 pushes to 0 ([#20363](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20363), [#20368](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20368)).
- **e2e shards are balanced by measured run time** against a five-minute target per shard, replacing the split by test count. Run-to-run variance remains, so the target is not a guarantee ([#20521](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20521), [#20522](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20522)).
- **A ruled-out components tier starts no runner either.** It used to boot three runners only to report a skip; its shards now skip at job level behind one `components` context ([#20595](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20595), [#20596](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20596)).
- **The repository's own guards run as one required context.** Fifteen guard commands from four standalone workflows now run as one list in the shared baseline's `guards` job, and the baseline reports three contexts where it reported ten. A pull request starts 3 baseline jobs instead of 10, and the `dev` ruleset requires 7 contexts instead of 16 ([#17171](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17171), [#20598](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20598)).
- **No Engine job checks out the Brain.** The guide lint now runs inside the shared baseline at its pinned release (`neo-agent-skills` 1.2.0) instead of cloning the Brain's `dev`, so a Brain push can no longer change an Engine pull request's verdict ([#20597](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20597), [#20612](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20612)). With that leaf, #20328 closed.

On the last night, a calendar-only fix ([#20578](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20578)) ran four of the tier's e2e spec files, its own two among them.

**The Brain-gated e2e tier retired on the cut day** ([#20451](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20451), [#20584](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20584)). In #20328's baseline it held about two thirds of Engine CI runner-minutes. Of the 71 spec files it gated:
- 61 moved into the engine tier, which now selects 196 of its 212 files. 54 moved with the retirement. Four followed once the off-socket adapter released a held worker session before a re-boot ([#20587](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20587), [#20615](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20615)), and two once it could bind a second browser context by worker id ([#20614](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20614), [#20621](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20621)). The Workstation film tour, excluded after a hosted flake, came back once its throw kept its momentum on a slow runner ([#20593](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20593), [#20601](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20601)).
- 10 stay local, each with its reason in `LOCAL_ONLY`: four test the Bridge itself, and six import Brain modules.

A pull request now starts no Brain-tier job, where it started up to ten shards before, and a full engine run is 14 jobs where the two tiers ran 18.

## 🔌 Neural Link specs without a Bridge

A Neural Link spec used to need the full cycle: the Brain's Bridge, a Brain checkout, and the Engine page on the other end. Discussion [#18775](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/18775) chose an off-socket adapter instead, which lets a single-app spec drive the page's own App Worker directly. Its epic, [#20370](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20370), landed in 13.4:
- the seam ([#20371](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20371), [#20381](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20381));
- the dedicated-worker adapter ([#20372](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20372), [#20373](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20373));
- spec selection ([#20374](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20374), [#20404](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20404));
- SharedWorker apps ([#20376](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20376), [#20461](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20461)).

The Brain keeps testing its own Bridge and tool definitions in its own repository. On the cut day [#20451](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20451) brought the rest across: a local probe ran 37 of the 42 window-driving specs clean off-socket, so they joined the engine tier ([#20584](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20584)). Four of the six window specs that still failed off-socket ([#20587](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20587)) followed the same evening. The adapter's session on the App SharedWorker had kept that worker alive past its last client, so a re-booted page reached a stale worker; the fixture now releases the session before a navigation ([#20615](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20615)). The last two bind a second browser context by worker id, and joined once the adapter could reach a worker in another context ([#20614](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20614), [#20621](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20621)).

## 🖱️ One drag sensor

Every drag in the engine starts in a main-thread sensor: dock tabs and tear-outs, splitters, grid column moves and resizes, calendar events, dialogs. Until 13.4 there were two sensors, one for mouse events and one for touch events. A drag that wandered over an iframe could go silent there, because the iframe took the moves and the release, so the drag never ended. [#17889](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17889) asked for Pointer Events with pointer capture. The roadmap had deferred it, and on the last night it nearly left the backlog (see *The last night*). It was built that night instead, from Grace's notes of September and Euclid's intake of 2026-11-07, and merged at 07:36Z ([#20585](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20585)).

`Neo.main.draggable.sensor.Pointer` replaces `Mouse` and `Touch`:
- one state machine hears `pointerdown`, `pointermove`, `pointerup` and `pointercancel` from mouse, touch and pen, and owns each gesture by its `pointerId`;
- it captures the pointer on the document root only once a drag passes its threshold, so a press that never becomes a drag still clicks its own element, and an engaged drag ends exactly once, over an iframe or not;
- a captured event names the document root, so the sensor adds the hit-test path as `eventPath` and `DragDrop` builds its targets from it; the `drag:*` payloads the App Worker receives are unchanged;
- the engine's own drag handles (splitters, resize handles, a draggable dialog's header) declare `touch-action: none`, and a custom handle opts in the same way (`src/main/draggable/README.md`).

**The proof:** a new component test drags across an iframe pane. On the old sensors no move arrives inside the iframe; on the new one the moves keep streaming there and the release ends the drag once. Before the merge, the full unit suite (6,656 tests), the full component suite (581) and 136 drag, dock, splitter and sort e2e tests passed locally, and hosted CI ran every tier the change reaches.

**A touch held still always arms.** The arm timer re-read `Date.now()`, which can show the delay a millisecond short: measured, 11 of 1,500 timers of 10 ms. When it did, the arm declined and nothing re-armed it, so a perfectly still finger never started its drag, and a unit test flaked in CI. The timer now tells the sensor its delay has elapsed ([#20636](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20636), [#20637](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20637)).

**Honest bounds:** touch was checked through Chrome DevTools Protocol emulation, not on a device. The operator's manual drag walk is the open post-merge check on [#20585](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20585).

## 📊 Grid

**Header groups** ([#20379](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20379), [#20397](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20397)). A `columns` entry with its own `columns` array is a group:

```javascript
columns: [
    {dataField: 'name', text: 'Name'},
    {text: 'Q1', columns: [{dataField: 'jan'}, {dataField: 'feb'}, {dataField: 'mar'}]}
]
```

The leaf header row does not change: sorting, resizing, filters, menus, drag and `aria-colindex` keep working on the same flat buttons. A group row is projected above it, one part per region, so locked columns get their own group cells.

The operator made "header groups finished" a second gate for this release. A verification matrix of 8 rows ran on [#20379](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20379), and every defect it found was fixed before the tag ([#20510](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20510), [#20511](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20511), [#20512](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20512), [#20517](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20517)). [#20571](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20571) made a cancelled header drag put the body cells back.

The operator's manual test of the demo then blocked the cut, and three more changes made it before the tag:
- **A header's drag proxy kept its header.** After a horizontal scroll, the proxy could show an empty slot where its header belonged. Every sort zone kept its previous drag's boundary, so the next drag's first move ran before that drag had started, and wrote screen coordinates into the header the proxy copies. A drag now ends by clearing its boundary ([#20626](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20626), [#20632](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20632)).
- **A grouped header's proxy stays over its group,** the rule its drop always followed. Past the group's edge the header waits in the edge slot, and a release keeps it there. The first fix slid the other headers back to their old order instead, and the operator's second pass rejected that (#20632).
- **A group header drags its whole group** between the other top-level headers ([#20627](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20627), [#20630](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20630)).

**CSV export** ([#20380](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20380), [#20389](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20389)). `grid.toCsv(options)` returns the store's current records as a string:
- columns run in display order under their header text;
- rows follow the store's filter and sort, including rows a buffered grid never rendered;
- quoting follows RFC 4180, lines end in CRLF, dates are ISO 8601, and `null` is an empty field;
- a formula guard, on by default (`escapeFormulas: false` turns it off), prefixes a string cell that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or CR.

`grid.exportCsv({fileName})` downloads the string. A column can override a cell through `exportRenderer({record, value})`.

**Nested data fields** ([#20359](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20359), [#20582](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20582)). A `dataField` such as `metrics.load` already worked in plain cells, sorting and filtering. Nine column types read their value themselves and missed the path: Progress, Sparkline, Tree, Icon, IconLink, LinkedIn, CountryFlag, AnimatedCurrency and AnimatedChange. They now read through one method, `Neo.grid.column.Base#getRecordValue`, which uses `Record#get` on records and `Neo.ns` on the plain objects of Turbo Mode rows. `AnimatedChange` animates when the value at the path moves, not when a sibling member of the same object changes.

**The multi-body grid, completed** ([#9486](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9486), [#9872](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9872), [#20499](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20499)). `Neo.grid.View` now owns the up to three bodies, `bodyStart`, `body` and `bodyEnd`. It creates and destroys them on a runtime lock change and hands configs across them, the same way the header wrapper does. That closes the epic for zero-jitter locked columns. Its cross-window follow-ons, detaching a locked region into its own window and syncing scroll over a direct channel, are now Discussion [#20579](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/20579).

**Smaller grid fixes:**
- tree rows announce their real expansion state ([#20566](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20566), [#20567](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20567));
- a re-added tree node keeps expanding after the store sorts ([#20568](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20568), [#20569](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20569));
- a header menu no longer throws over a retired trigger ([#20564](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20564), [#20546](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20546)).

## ⏳ Requests that waited years

105 issues filed before 2025 closed in this window. 92 were completed, 80 of them by a pull request. The oldest were filed in the engine's first weeks on GitHub, in November 2019:
- **Closable tabs**, `tab.Container` ([#26](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/26), [#20399](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20399)).
- **Docs app:** routes for class tabs, so a reload restores the open class, filed the day 1.0.0 shipped ([#24](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/24), [#20620](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20620)); tab header tooltips ([#29](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/29), [#20224](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20224)), theme button texts ([#45](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/45), [#20272](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20272)) and the mixins of a class ([#99](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/99), [#20327](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20327)).
- **`DateSelector`:** keyboard navigation and selection ([#44](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/44), [#20316](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20316)), with arrow navigation no longer stopping at the current month ([#47](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/47), [#20247](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20247)).

2020 followed close behind:
- the gallery's loading spinner ([#290](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/290), [#20343](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20343));
- the Helix selection model's `toggleSelection` ([#318](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/318), [#20203](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20203));
- the calendar's 12- and 24-hour time axis ([#941](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/941), [#20326](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20326)), plus its month view's wheel, font-size and scroll fixes ([#989](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/989), [#991](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/991), [#992](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/992));
- the week view's infinite scrolling ([#1069](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/1069), [#20360](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20360)).

- @kaushlendra-pt-singh fixed the calendar week-view example that threw on load ([#19930](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19930) → [#19958](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19958)), one of the two broken examples 13.3.0 left open as good first issues, and pinned the number field's spin-button trigger ([#19144](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19144) → [#20123](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20123)).

- @anasdahani220 made the Neural Link e2e fixture name `NEO_NL_PORT` when a seat's fleet Bridge refuses it ([#20339](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20339) → [#20386](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20386)).
- Four pinned an engine behaviour with tests: @calude-bot, `HashHistory`'s one route stack per browser window ([#19132](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19132) → [#20197](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20197)); @Toufiqul-27, when the toast manager refuses a toast ([#19147](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19147) → [#20191](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20191)); @SimonGebru, how the currency field parses and renders amounts ([#19129](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19129) → [#20157](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20157)); and @Athmika08, how `Neo.util.CountryFlags` turns a location into a flag ([#19177](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19177) → [#20094](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20094)).

Thank you, all eight. New [good first issues](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20is%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22) are filed as the team finds them: comment on an unassigned one to claim it. The claim holds for 7 days from your latest comment there ([#20616](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20616), [#20617](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20617)).

## 🧰 Also in 13.4

- **Data:** store pipelines compose awaited interceptors ([#9553](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/9553), [#20487](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20487)).
- **Events:** a Function passed to `un()` or `removeListener()` now removes the function registered with it, by identity ([#20560](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20560), [#20561](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20561)).
- **Calendar:** pressing Escape during an event drag puts the event back instead of moving it ([#20577](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20577), [#20578](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20578)).
- **Responsive:** `Neo.plugin.Responsive` binds to the matching viewport on mount and rebinds when a component moves to another window ([#20334](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20334)).
- **Package:** the npm package no longer ships the Agent OS concept ontology; it lives in the Agent OS plane ([#19093](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19093), [#20580](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20580)).
- **Tabs:** a tab chosen from `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow`'s menu moves the route as its header would: a plain route replaces the hash, and an `editRoute` header merges its fields into it ([#20599](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20599), [#20603](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20603)).
- **Portal:** the news section gains a Videos tab; each film stays a click-to-play facade until a visitor starts it, and at most one plays ([#20589](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20589), [#20594](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20594)).
- **Dependencies:** Dependabot proposes updates every day, weekends included, so a release shipped on a Saturday or Sunday no longer waits until Monday ([#20606](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20606), [#20607](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20607)). Its first run after the change brought Playwright 1.65, with the copied Chromium launch defaults refreshed to match ([#20613](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20613), [#20608](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20608)). A new Skills workflow release is proposed on its next run instead of three days later ([#20618](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20618), [#20619](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20619)).
- **Workstation:** a popup the browser refuses explains, in a hint that leaves the page usable, how to allow it ([#19537](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19537), [#20623](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20623)).
- **Drag:** `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` gains two protected hooks, `getPinnedItems` and `getDragElement`. A subclass can now keep non-sortable siblings in place during a drag and clone a handle into the drag proxy without copying the drag lifecycle ([#20605](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20605), [#20611](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20611)).
- **Forms, components and docs:** the long tail of requests above, listed in the *Full Changelog*.

## ⬆️ Upgrading from 13.3.1

**What did not change:** `package.json`'s `main`, `exports`, `bin`, `engines` and `type` are the same as in 13.3.1. The rest of the file changes like this:
- three npm scripts are new: `create-theme`, `move-files` and `seat:start`;
- the `dompurify` range moves to `^3.4.17`;
- dev tooling adds three PostCSS packages and moves `neo-agent-skills` from 0.1.56 to 1.2.0.

**Public behaviour to check:**

| If your code… | In 13.4 | Do this |
|---|---|---|
| imports `CountryFlag`, `GitHubOrgs`, `GitHubUser` or `IconLink` from `src/component/`, or names their old `className` | they live in `src/grid/column/component/` as `Neo.grid.column.component.*`; the column types `countryFlag`, `githubOrgs`, `githubUser`, `iconLink` and `linkedin` are unchanged ([#20470](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20470)) | update the import path or the `className` |
| uses the `Neo.Responsive` global | it is gone; `Neo.plugin.Responsive` keeps its configuration per instance ([#20334](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20334)) | use the plugin |
| gives a Button a `route` and relies on `Neo.Main.editRoute` | `editRoute` defaults to `false`, so the button renders as an anchor and the browser follows the route ([#20342](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20342)) | set `editRoute: true` to keep the old dispatch |
| declares a StateProvider `stores` entry without `module`, `className` or `ntype` | it becomes a `Neo.data.Store`; before, the entry silently ended up `null`. An entry with an explicit `className` keeps its class ([#20214](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20214)) | nothing, unless your code relied on that `null` |
| removes a listener by passing a Function to `un()` or `removeListener()` | the Function is matched by identity, so only the function that was registered is removed. Before, a different function with the same name could match ([#20561](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20561)) | keep the registered Function, or the subscription id `on()` returned, and remove with that. A String passed as the second argument is still read as a subscription id, as in 13.3.1 |
| reads `.neo-ai-data/concepts/` from the npm package | the package no longer ships it ([#20580](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20580)) | nothing for apps |
| points one of the nine column types above at a dotted `dataField` | the path resolves as in a plain cell ([#20582](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20582)) | nothing; values that rendered empty now show |
| imports `src/main/draggable/sensor/Mouse.mjs` or `Touch.mjs`, or names `Neo.main.draggable.sensor.Mouse` or `.Touch` | both are gone; `Neo.main.draggable.sensor.Pointer` replaces them, and `DragDrop` exposes it as `pointerSensor` and `getPointerSensor()`, keeping `mouseSensor` and `getMouseSensor()` as deprecated aliases ([#20585](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20585)) | use the Pointer sensor through `pointerSensor` or `getPointerSensor()` |
| sends raw `mousedown`, `mousemove` or `mouseup` through `EventSimulator#dispatch`, for example from the Neural Link's `simulate_event` | each one is preceded by the pointer event a real mouse fires, with one synthetic `pointerId`, so a simulated gesture arms a drag as real input does; mouse listeners receive the same events as before ([#20585](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20585)) | nothing, unless a listener counts every pointer event |
| handles the `click` a browser fires after a drag ends | past the drag threshold the sensor captures the pointer on the document root, so that click lands on `html` and no component receives it; a press that never becomes a drag still clicks its own element ([#20585](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20585)) | nothing, unless your code relied on the post-drag click |
| runs `build-all` for a workspace | the production build fails when a `.js` or `.mjs` file under the build folder contains `file:///`, the path an inlined `import.meta.url` leaves, and the message names the file ([#20602](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20602)) | keep `import.meta.url` a runtime value in your own webpack config, for example with `module.parser.javascript.importMeta: false` |

## 🧭 What comes next

The roadmap for the next release is set after this cut. The backlog keeps standing bands from here on: under 25 open issues is green, 25 to 50 orange, over 50 red. A clean slate leaves room for new tickets, and the bands keep it from growing back. Open from this window:
- the Grid-family examples with captions ([#20500](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20500));
- modern themes and a theme switch for the header groups demo, held back so the cut's manual test judged the demo as it ships ([#20635](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20635)).
